description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Annual Imporvements to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRSS) 2014
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the adoption of amendments to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRSs) under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It involves legal/regulatory matters concerning financial reporting standards and compliance requirements, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
